verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with and query projects. Its plugin bundles that server so agents can query the database, manage migrations and deploy Edge Functions. A runtime probe confirmed the hosted endpoint at mcp.supabase.com is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. Community reports of prompt-injection risk concern safe use, not whether the server works, so they lower nothing beyond noting the risk. Missing for 10: first-party documentation in the pack of the full tool list and the read-only/permission scoping options (read-only mode appears only in a community comment).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Once connected, your AI assistants can interact with and query your Supabase projects on your behalf.
It bundles the Supabase MCP server and Supabase agent skills so your agent can query your database, manage migrations, deploy Edge Functions
the documented remote MCP endpoint is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow
